Aisha R: Quick question - my partner just got a job with benefits and we'd like to remove them from my medical but keep dental. Is that allowed mid-year and how do deductions get handled?

Evan (People Ops): Congrats! This is typically a QLE (Qualifying Life Event). Youll need to submit proof of their employer coverage within 31 days. You can change individual plans (e.g., remove from medical, keep dental). Deductions are adjusted prospectively from the effective date or the next payroll cycle after processing.

Aisha R: What counts as acceptable proof? They have an online enrollment confirmation but its behind login.

Evan (People Ops): We accept: employer enrollment confirmation email, screenshot of benefits portal showing active coverage and effective date, or an employer-signed letter. If its behind login, a screenshot with the employee name, employer name, and coverage start date usually works. Upload via the Benefits portal -> "Midyear dependent change (QLE)".

Aisha R: If their coverage started 6/10 but I submit paperwork on 6/25, will deductions be refunded back to 6/10?

Payroll Bot: Payroll cycles: 1st and 15th. Cutoff for processing changes for the 7/1 paycheck is 6/20 5pm PT. Changes approved after cutoff apply to the next cycle. Refunds for prior pay periods are uncommon and require manual review.

Liam - Benefits Carrier: Hi Aisha  I work on carrier verifications. We verify effective date from the employer docs; if coverage shows active on 6/10, we can confirm that effective date. Retroactive premium refunds depend on plan rules and require proof that premiums were billed in error.

Aisha R: Ok so likely no automatic refund, but payroll stops taking deductions going forward once approved. If I keep dental, do I need a separate form?

Evan (People Ops): No separate form needed. On the QLE change page select the plans you want to update. Example selection: Event type: QLE, Reason: Partner gained employer coverage, Effective date: 2026-06-10, Plans affected: Medical - Remove dependent, Dental - Keep dependent. Attach proof and add a short note.

Aisha R: Done. Uploaded screenshot and selected only medical to remove.

Evan (People Ops): Got it, Ive created case BEN-26-334 and flagged for carrier verification. Expect confirmation in 3-5 business days. If verified and approved before the payroll cutoff, Payroll Bot will stop medical deductions the next applicable cycle.

Payroll Bot: Noted. If approval lands before 6/20 cutoff, deductions will stop starting 7/1. If after, they stop 7/15. No promise of retro refund without manual carrier confirmation.

Aisha R: Thanks all! Appreciate the clarity.
